# Jonathan Rice

Jonathan Rice is currently working as a Financial Stability Expert at the European Central Bank on topics relating to financial stability and systemic risk. His research interests span topics in banking, artificial intelligence and the international transmission of macroeconomic and financial shocks. He holds a PhD in Economics from Trinity College, Dublin.

<p class="keywords"><strong>Research interests</strong> Banking, artificial intelligence, international transmission of macroeconomic and financial shocks, financial stability and systemic risk</p>
